output.filing_type_name: Its type by name, such as '4th Quarter Report'.
output.filing_uuid: The filing's UUID, such as 5feb9933-1ef3-43d3-9d42-a558a4ca11cf: what 'Get a filing' takes.
output.filing_year: The year it covers, such as 2025.
output.government_entities: The parts of the government contacted, such as SENATE or the FCC.
output.income: What a lobbying firm was paid by the client in the period, in dollars.
output.issue_areas: The issue areas lobbied on, by name, such as Taxation/Internal Revenue Code.
output.issue_codes: The issue areas lobbied on, as codes such as TAX.
output.posted_at: When it was posted publicly, in US Eastern time with its offset, such as 2026-10-23T15:36:13-04:00.
output.registrant_id: The registrant's Senate ID: what 'Get a registrant' takes.
output.registrant_name: The registrant: the lobbying firm, or the organization lobbying for itself.
output.specific_issues: What was lobbied on, in the filer's words: bills, rules and programs.

parameters.description: Whom the lobbying is for: a name or part of it, such as Microsoft, or a client ID. Give this, a registrant, a lobbyist, issue words, or a mix.
parameters.name: client

parameters.description: The lobbying firm or organization: its name or part of it, such as Akin Gump, or its ID.
parameters.name: registrant

parameters.description: A lobbyist: their name or part of it, such as William Gwinn, or their ID.
parameters.name: lobbyist

parameters.description: Words in what is lobbied on, such as a bill number or a subject. Put a phrase in double quotes: "artificial intelligence".
parameters.name: issue_words

parameters.description: Only filings that lobby in this issue area, such as Taxation. Leave blank for every area.
parameters.name: issue_area

parameters.description: Only registrations (a new client), quarterly reports, amendments or terminations. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: filing_kind
